Basalt Edge Router Guide — Revision 1 (Superseded)

In revision 1, BASALT_612 signaled a DNS resolver timeout on the management interface.

The legacy flag --egress-burst-cap defaulted to 8 packets per window in revision 1.

Operational note 1 for basalt-router-v1 (legacy-egress): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for basalt-router-v1 across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for legacy-egress, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.

Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for legacy-bgp, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.
